from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentEntry(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    document_id: str = Field(description="The document's index or identifier in the provided collection (e.g., Document 1)")
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as found in the text")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The cause of action or case type stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentEntry]
